# Copilot Instructions — BRS to Backlog Workflow

You are supporting a structured BRS-to-backlog workflow.

Always follow these principles:

1. Do not jump directly from BRS to implementation.
2. Preserve traceability from source BRS text to capabilities, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and tests.
3. Prefer business capability grouping over BRS section grouping.
4. Separate facts from assumptions.
5. Mark low-confidence interpretations clearly.
6. Ask clarification questions only when required, but still produce useful draft outputs with assumptions.
7. Do not invent business rules, systems, users, or compliance requirements not supported by the BRS or architecture.
8. Make outputs usable by business, IT, architecture, QA, and delivery leads.
9. Keep stories testable, small, and independently reviewable.
10. Treat backlog review as mandatory before GitHub issue creation.

Default output location:

```text
/output
```

Default input location:

```text
/input/brs.md
/input/architecture.md
```
